paragraphs.en: SBVul用两阶段智能体定位C/C++函数中的可利用漏洞语句，语句级召回达60.5%。 Many recent approaches for vulnerability detection use large language models (LLMs) to classify functions as vulnerable or benign, leaving developers to locate the exploitable statements. Furthermore, while these approaches have shown performance improvements, they still fall short in distinguishing vulnerable from patched real-world functions. This paper presents SBVul, an agentic approach that detects exploitable statements in C/C++ functions. In Phase~1, an LLM agent explores the function and its repository and identifies candidate statements. In Phase~2, a second agent analyzes the control and data flow of each candidate and confirms it, rules it out, or marks it uncertain. We created a manually verified ground truth of exploitable statements for 200 pairs of the PrimeVul Paired test set and ran SBVul with the open-weight models Qwen 3.8 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Anthropic's Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5. Phase~1 identifies ground-truth statements in 56--77% of the vulnerable functions, and Phase~2 confirms such a statement with an explanation accepted by an LLM judge in 26--73%. However, all models also confirm candidates in 23--61% of the patched functions. Across vulnerable and patched functions, the highest statement-level precision is 0.315 at a recall of 0.605 obtained with Opus 5.5 (xhigh). At the function level, SBVul with Opus 5.5 classifies 42.0% of the pairs correctly, compared with 33.8% reported for the best previous approach.
paragraphs.zh: SBVul用两阶段智能体定位C/C++函数中的可利用漏洞语句，语句级召回达60.5%。许多近期的漏洞检测方法使用大语言模型（LLM）将函数分类为有漏洞或良性，而把定位可利用语句的工作留给开发者。 此外，尽管这些方法在性能上有所提升，但它们在区分真实世界中有漏洞的函数和已修复的函数方面仍然不足。 本文提出SBVul，一种检测C/C++函数中可利用语句的智能体方法。 在第1阶段，一个LLM智能体探索该函数及其代码仓库，并识别候选语句。 在第2阶段，第二个智能体分析每个候选语句的控制流和数据流，然后予以确认、排除或标记为不确定。 我们为PrimeVul Paired测试集中的200对函数人工核验并构建了可利用语句的真实标注，并使用开源权重模型Qwen 3.8和DeepSeek V4.1 Flash以及Anthropic的Sonnet 5.5和Opus 5.5运行SBVul。 第1阶段在56%至77%的有漏洞函数中识别出真实标注语句，第2阶段以LLM评审员可接受的解释确认此类语句的比例为26%至73%。 然而，所有模型在23%至61%的已修复函数中也确认了候选语句。 在有漏洞函数和已修复函数的总体上，使用Opus 5.5（xhigh）获得的最高语句级精确率为0.315，召回率为0.605。 在函数级别，使用Opus 5.5的SBVul正确分类了42.0%的函数对，而此前最佳方法报告的数字为33.8%。
